title: How Does Your Phone Screen Sense Your Finger?
topic: How a touchscreen senses your finger
description: Discover how capacitive touchscreens use an invisible electrostatic grid to detect your finger's natural electrical charge. Learn why regular gloves block your taps while your skin acts as a conductor to register every swipe. Subscribe and follow us for more.
